name: HashiCorp Terraform Associate

fee.note: USD 70.50 plus locally applicable taxes and fees; no free retake included.

exam.format: One-hour online proctored exam (through Certiverse) of true/false, multiple-choice and multiple-answer questions on Terraform 1.12, in English only. Credentials are valid for two years.

access.retake: No free retake: each attempt is a new purchase, with 7 days between attempts, at most 4 attempts in a rolling 365 days, and no retake of a passed exam until the credential expires.
access.accommodations: Accommodations, including extra time, are requested in Certiverse while scheduling, at least 3 business days ahead; candidates whose first language is not English can ask for extra time (HashiCorp asks for 5 business days' notice).

scope: Infrastructure as code with Terraform: core workflow, state, modules and configuration. It validates infrastructure skills, not AI.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: HashiCorp does not publish the passing score or the number of questions.

Recertification opens 18 months after the credential is earned (six months before it expires): retake the current Associate exam, or pass the Terraform Professional or a Terraform Authoring and Operations Advanced exam.
